decisions.reason: As a core bakery item close to the firm's existing craft, sourcing, and sales routines, the loaf is inexpensive to keep testing and there is no clear negative signal yet.

The guided historic mill tour fits the firm's heritage and hospitality offer, but it likely uses more staff time and depends on visitor demand, so it is kept as a still-uncertain option with somewhat higher exit risk.

A sweet pastry is strongly aligned with the firm's confectionery business and can be maintained with limited incremental commitment while management learns whether it earns a stable place in the assortment.
